## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

The *Pathavicalanapañha* ("The Question on the Causes of Earthquakes", Mil 5.1.4) is a dialogue situated within the *Milindapañha*. The work investigates the doctrinal and cosmological reasons for the trembling of the earth, a topic with notable roots across canonical Buddhist literature. English translations of the text include one by John Kelly.
